prompt: A spray-painted stencil graffiti of a fox head with three real eyes: two normal eyes and a large third eye in the center of its forehead, the third eye the same almond shape as the others with a visible iris and pupil, wide open and staring straight at the viewer. The fox is bold black stencil spray paint with sharp angular woodcut-style cuts, tall pointed ears with small hoop earrings, and a sly knowing look; the third eye is filled with bright blood-red spray paint so it stands out first, with thin red drips running down from it. It is painted on a weathered grey concrete wall in an abandoned rail yard, with stains, cracks, faded old tags and a torn paper flyer at one edge. Flat overcast daylight, camera straight on to the wall, the fox head centered and filling about two thirds of the frame. Desaturated grey palette with only black and red paint.
